stage: CUBE-REV 0.10.5-R1.9 — Phase-objective Quotient Geometry, Attempt-level Familywise Null Preregistration & Fresh-vintage Replication Readiness

local_reference_rule.purpose: Map heterogeneous phase/channel amplitudes to conservative empirical tail scores before the attempt-level maximum is formed.
local_reference_rule.tail_probability: add-one conservative empirical upper-tail probability: (1 + # reference amplitudes >= observed amplitude) / (n + 1)

familywise_rule.attempt_statistic: Maximum local tail_score over all eligible phase-line objective and anchor channels in one official attempt.
familywise_rule.crossfit: Deterministic 5-fold split by SHA-256 of official-attempt key and R1.9 salt. Each held-out attempt is scored only against reference envelopes from the other four folds.
familywise_rule.multiplicity_conditioning: Familywise reference is conditioned by eligible feature-count bin: 1-8, 9-12, 13-16, 17+ when bin n>=300; otherwise global. Method×feature-count may be used only when n>=300 and is predeclared before execution; fallback order is method×count -> count -> method -> global with n>=300 for non-global levels.
familywise_rule.future_familywise_p: For a fresh attempt, score against the full sealed historical local reference, then compute add-one upper-tail probability against the sealed cross-fitted historical attempt-statistic reference at the highest supported multiplicity-conditioning level.
familywise_rule.calibration_health_gate: Across five held-out folds, empirical primary-alpha exceedance must lie in [0.003,0.02] overall; secondary-watch exceedance must lie in [0.025,0.08]. These are engineering calibration-health bands, not hypothesis-test acceptance regions.
